title: resolve_id / save_issue keep I/O interleaved with pure logic - ARCHITECTURE's match_id_prefix example was never implemented
description: ARCHITECTURE.md 'Testing Functional Core vs Imperative Shell' uses resolve_id as the textbook counterexample and prescribes extracting pure match_id_prefix(id_str, known_ids) -> Result<Uuid> (ARCHITECTURE.md:290). That extraction was never done: Operations::resolve_id (operations.rs:784-807) still loads the index and prefix-matches in one function; Storage::save_issue (storage.rs:138-172) interleaves the rename/index-dirty decision with fs::remove_file/fs::write. rg 'match_id_prefix' finds nothing. Consequence: ambiguous/unknown-prefix resolution and rename-vs-no-rename branch logic have no unit tests (operations.rs has 7 tests, all parse_id_input_line; storage.rs has 0). Fix: extract the pure decision functions per ARCHITECTURE.md's own example and add unit tests for ambiguous/unknown prefixes, case-insensitivity boundaries, rename vs no-rename. From sonnet-latest design review 2026-09-22.
